Package Fitness.ClientPackage

Class ProgressTrackingPage

java.lang.Object
Fitness.ClientPackage.ProgressTrackingPage
public class ProgressTrackingPage extends Object
This class represents the progress tracking page, where the user can track their weight, BMI, attendance, achievements, milestones, and progress chart. The user can also provide ratings, reviews, and suggestions for the program.
Author:
Abdulrhman M Sawalmeh
